scope: selected parent cold canonical serialization and root participation

runtime_root.lifecycle: query, allocate, full-zero, construct pointer-rich owner, consume in memory, terminal close and destroy

pointer_rich_state.description: The runtime allocation contains process-relative pointers, nested runtime owners, working buffers, descriptors and scratch-like state.

cross_profile_actual_runs.limit: Only the executed profiles and exact target functions are covered.

BOUNDED_NO_HIT.claim_limit: No-hit evidence is bounded evidence. It does not prove that canonical serialization, parsing, digests, receipts or persistence are permanently absent from every binary, workflow, build or profile.

UNKNOWN: serializer, parser, digest or receipt behavior in unexecuted workflows, other builds and other configurations
alternate consumers in other bundled DLLs outside the bounded call graphs and executed profiles
whether a product-wide orchestration layer persists a different logical state representation
human semantic names for measurement offsets 8, 12 and 16
cross-profile behavior of the generic whole120 setter when its guard is satisfied
any vendor-defined portable parent state format outside the admitted evidence

CLEAN_ROOM_DESIGN.logical_root_purpose: Provide deterministic comparison, transaction ownership, failure atomicity and fresh reconstruction identity without copying native runtime memory.
required_schema_decisions: primitive endian, alignment and terminal rule
digest domain and exact canonical preimage
required_validation: complete cold vector with per-section offsets, total length and SHA-256
positive constructor receipt with one commit
invalid-provider and invalid-schema receipts with zero commit
terminal destroy followed by fresh-object reconstruction equality

minimum_missing_facts.fact: One approved canonical logical-state framing resolving all five open framing categories without alternatives.
minimum_missing_facts.blocking_impact: Without it there is no authoritative preimage, length, section map or state SHA for the parent root.

minimum_missing_facts.fact: A complete cold vector and independent parser/serializer roundtrip derived from the approved schema and selected v34 logical inputs.
minimum_missing_facts.blocking_impact: Without it the schema cannot be shown executable, unambiguous or free of pointers, padding and scratch.

minimum_missing_facts.fact: Typed constructor and root receipt schemas with owner token, generation, provider identity, before/after digest and commit/failure rules.
minimum_missing_facts.blocking_impact: Without them the runtime parent cannot participate in the clean global root transaction even though native construction and fresh reconstruction are understood.
